items.title: Monaco assassination plot takes a new turn
items.description: A woman suspected of plotting to assassinate a Ukrainian-Cypriot businessman in Monaco has been found dead in Ukraine. Two men with ties to Ukraine's intelligence services have now been brought into custody.

items.title: Zelenskyy fires Ukraine's tech-savvy defense minister in government reshuffle
items.description: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has fired the country's popular defense minister, who pushed for innovation in the battlefield through the use of drones and turned the tables on Russia.

items.title: Departure of Ukraine's popular defense minister sparks protests
items.description: Rallies in support of Mykhailo Fedorov, Ukraine's young and popular defense minister, were held in Kyiv and around the country on Thursday, after President Volodymyr Zelensky angered politicians, military officials and the general public by announcing his removal the previous day.

items.title: Russian attacks kill 14 as Ukraine hits Black Sea oil tankers
items.description: Civilian casualties are reported in a number of Ukrainian regions, while Kyiv hits 20 Russian vessels in the Black Sea.

items.title: Russia Fires 6,001 Drones, 170 Bombs as Ukraine Repels 235 Clashes
items.description: The Armed Forces of Ukraine repelled 235 clashes across the front line on Wednesday, July 15, with the heaviest fighting near Pokrovsk and Kostiantynivka. Russian forces used 170 guided bombs and 6,001 kamikaze drones during the assault.

items.title: Russian Attack on Odesa Kills 3 as Ukraine Strikes Ships in Black Sea
items.description: Ukraine's top drone commander said Wednesday that Kyiv hit 20 Russian vessels in the Black Sea overnight.

items.title: After Double Amputation, Ukrainian Vet Says 'Thirst For Independence' Led The Way To Recovery
items.description: Ukrainian soldier Artem lost both his arms in combat near Pokrovske, a frontline village in Ukraine's Dnipropetrovsk region. items.title: Winter was harsh, but resilient Odesa making summer a season of hope
items.description: Odesa, home to a Ukrainian seaport that is a critical link in the global food security chain, endured its worst winter of Russian attacks since the war began, then prepared for a vibrant summer with a determination not just to survive but to build a better future.
